prompt.zh-TW: 小山咖啡向銀行借了 {{money:vars.loan}}，錢已經進了店的帳戶。這筆錢在資產負債表上要怎麼記？
prompt.en: Hillside Coffee borrows {{money:vars.loan}} from the bank, and the money is now in the shop’s account. How is it recorded on the balance sheet?

text.zh-TW: 現金增加，同時短期借款（負債）增加同樣的金額
text.en: Cash rises, and short-term borrowings (a liability) rise by the same amount

short.zh-TW: 現金與短期借款一起增加

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。錢在店裡，但它是欠銀行的，所以右邊記負債。
feedback.en: Nice work. The money is in the shop, but it is owed to the bank, so it goes on the right as a liability.

text.zh-TW: 現金增加，股東權益也增加，因為錢已經是店的了
text.en: Cash rises and equity rises too, because the money now belongs to the shop

feedback.zh-TW: 現金確實變多了，這點沒錯。不過這筆錢要還給銀行，不是股東的；股東權益只記股東投入和店自己賺來的錢，借來的錢記在負債。
feedback.en: Cash has indeed grown, that much is right. But this money must be repaid to the bank and does not belong to the shareholders; equity records only what the shareholders put in and what the shop earned, while borrowed money is a liability.

text.zh-TW: 現金增加，營業收入也增加
text.en: Cash rises and revenue rises too

feedback.zh-TW: 你看到有錢進來，這點沒錯。不過收入是賣咖啡賺來的錢；借款只是暫時放在店裡、以後要還的錢，和賺錢無關。
feedback.en: You can see money coming in, which is right. But revenue is money earned by selling coffee; a loan is money parked in the shop that must be repaid later, and has nothing to do with earning.

explanation.zh-TW: 店裡的錢有三種來源：賺來的、股東出的、借來的。借來的錢在資產負債表右邊記成{{term:tm_h6p2k9wd}}，所以是{{option:o_y8aj}}。{{option:o_swgc}}把欠銀行的錢當成股東的，{{option:o_n855}}把借錢當成賺錢。
explanation.en: Money in the shop comes from three sources: earned, put in by shareholders, or borrowed. Borrowed money is recorded on the right of the balance sheet under {{term:tm_h6p2k9wd}}, so the answer is {{option:o_y8aj}}. {{option:o_swgc}} treats money owed to the bank as the shareholders’, and {{option:o_n855}} treats borrowing as earning.
